creator: Alexander Terp
description:
Seen 2026-09-28 03:26 in Muster v2 (signed bundle, muster-daemon from the cut-over branch before it landed) while three `./dev` gates ran at nice 10: load average 175-240. `muster pane read` through the window took 13 s, and one attempt failed with "the daemon local did not answer within 10s". A `pane send` to the same pane landed. The daemon process sat at 0.9% CPU, so it was waiting rather than busy: a lock held across slow work, a thread starved despite its QoS, or the app side of the request.

This is the failure that made herdr unusable under the same load (median 1.2 s, max 5 s for zoom), and MIP-3 promised muster-daemon would not have it. The quiet-machine `--latency` tier cannot see it: it needs a measurement under load. The daemon log and the app run log for that minute should show where the time went.
title: Under heavy load the daemon takes over 10 s to answer a pane read
